DS-210 Introduction to Data Science
Assignment 2: Exploratory Analysis of City Air Quality

Dataset: air_quality.csv (provided on the course page) contains hourly PM2.5, PM10, NO2 and temperature readings for 5 cities over 2025.

Tasks
(a) Load the dataset and handle missing values. You must document which strategy (dropping or imputation) you used and why.
(b) Compute monthly average PM2.5 for every city and present them in a table.
(c) Produce at least three plots: a time-series of PM2.5 for each city, a box plot comparing cities, and a correlation heatmap of the four variables.
(d) Identify the city with the worst air quality and justify your answer using the data.
(e) Test whether PM2.5 levels in winter (Dec–Feb) are significantly higher than in summer (Apr–Jun) using an appropriate statistical test at the 5% significance level.

Rules
- Use Python with pandas, matplotlib or seaborn, and scipy. No spreadsheets.
- Your notebook must run top-to-bottom without errors on a fresh kernel.
- Work individually; plagiarism will be reported.

Submit a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb) and an exported HTML version of the same notebook.

Grading
Data cleaning: 10
Monthly averages table: 10
Plots: 20
Worst city analysis: 15
Hypothesis test: 25
Presentation and clarity: 20
(Total 100)
